# THE ENGRAVED SKY - client facts

## Edition
- Title: THE ENGRAVED SKY
- Cover descriptor: Nineteen Plates of the Historical Sky
- Imprint: Meridian Sheet Press
- ISBN: 978-1-7396-4412-8
- Trim size: 240 × 300 mm, portrait
- Extent: 128 pages
- Text stock: 150 gsm matt coated
- Binding: section-sewn paperback
- Spine width: 12 mm at 128 pages
- Spine text direction: top to bottom
- Print run: 600 copies, short-run digital, four-colour
- Primary ink: #1B2A4A
- ISBN barcode: back cover, lower right, 40 × 25 mm
- Cover thumbnail state: front cover at 24 mm wide
- Reader: adults with an interest in the night sky and old printed matter

## Grid and type
| Field | Value |

| Page grid | 6 columns |
| Column width | 29.5 mm |
| Column gutter | 5 mm |
| Inner margin | 20 mm |
| Outer margin | 18 mm |
| Head margin | 20 mm |
| Foot margin | 24 mm |
| Type area | 202 × 256 mm |
| Baseline grid | 4 mm, 64 lines per page |
| Caption zone | lowest 34 mm of the type area |
| Bleed | 3 mm on all outer edges |
| Running text | 10 pt serif |
| Caption text | 8 pt sans-serif |

## Caption fields, in order
1. Collection title, as recorded in 03-plate-records.md
2. Accession number

steps.userMessage:
THE ENGRAVED SKY | Reader of nineteen historical astronomy plates

Meridian Sheet Press is re-editing nineteen public-domain astronomy plates from Wellcome Collection into a reader that an adult can sit and read through and also look things up in. Nineteen plates, five chapters, names fixed: 1 Coloured Constellation Cards (nine plates), 2 Charts by Right Ascension (two plates), 3 Whole-Sky and Cosmography (three plates), 4 Instruments (two plates), 5 Comets and Observation (three plates). The plates argue with each other: plate-03 is a small hand-coloured card, plate-14 is a whole sheet of engraved panel lettering, plate-18 arrives with two columns of its own printed caption text, and plate-01 and plate-10 are the same constellation drawn twice, once as a coloured card and once as a line projection corrected to 1808. One grid has to hold all of them.

The book is 240 × 300 mm portrait, 128 pages, 150 gsm matt coated text stock, section-sewn paperback, spine 12 mm, printed four-colour in a run of 600. Primary ink #1B2A4A. The page grid is six columns of 29.5 mm with 5 mm gutters, inner margin 20 mm, outer 18 mm, head 20 mm, foot 24 mm, and the caption of every plate spread sits in the lowest 34 mm of the type area. Each plate caption carries four fields in this order: the collection title as recorded, the accession number, the catalogue date and maker line, and the credit. Credit the source as "Wellcome Collection" and give the rights label Public Domain Mark. Where the catalogue records no year, print "No date recorded"; where it records no maker, print "No maker recorded". The front cover carries the title THE ENGRAVED SKY and the descriptor "Nineteen Plates of the Historical Sky", the spine reads top to bottom, the imprint is Meridian Sheet Press, and the ISBN 978-1-7396-4412-8 barcode sits in the lower right of the back cover at 40 × 25 mm.

Audience: the imprint's editor and production manager, who choose which layout goes to press and hand the pages to the printer.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md holds the format, grid and printed strings; 03-plate-records.md holds the nineteen collection titles, accession numbers, catalogue date and maker lines and the lettering read on each plate; book-format-plan.png gives the trim, bleed, spread grid and cover flat in millimetres; plate-01.jpg, plate-02.jpg, plate-03.jpg, plate-04.jpg, plate-05.jpg, plate-06.jpg, plate-07.jpg, plate-08.jpg, plate-09.jpg, plate-10.jpg, plate-11.jpg, plate-12.jpg, plate-13.jpg, plate-14.jpg, plate-15.jpg, plate-16.jpg, plate-17.jpg, plate-18.jpg and plate-19.jpg are the nineteen plates themselves; empty-bookshop-table.png is the shop context the finished copy sits in; 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the files to return.

Deliverables:
1. Three distinct layout directions, one board each, every board setting the same two plates, plate-03 and plate-18, so the three directions can be compared on the widest gap in text density
2. One layout specification sheet naming the selected direction and stating trim 240 × 300 mm, 128 pages, spine 12 mm, the six-column 29.5 mm grid and the four caption fields in order
3. The cover in three states: the flat with back cover, 12 mm spine and front cover; a three-dimensional shot of the bound copy standing on the bare display table of empty-bookshop-table.png; the front cover at 24 mm wide as a thumbnail
4. Five chapter opener pages, one for each chapter, each reproducing its own chapter's plates as thumbnails: Coloured Constellation Cards nine, Charts by Right Ascension two, Whole-Sky and Cosmography three, Instruments two, Comets and Observation three
5. Eight plate spreads, one each for plate-01, plate-03, plate-09, plate-10, plate-13, plate-14, plate-18 and plate-19, each carrying its four caption fields
6. Two index spreads splitting the pack in half: plate-01 to plate-10 as thumbnails ordered by accession number, and plate-11 to plate-19 as thumbnails ordered by collection title
7. One 12-second video turning from the cover through two chapter openers to the plate-14 and plate-18 spreads
8. One presentation document of at least eight pages, naming the selected direction on page one and reusing the cover states, the five openers, the eight spreads and both index spreads

Acceptance:
- The specification sheet names one of the three direction boards as selected, and all five openers, all eight spreads, both index spreads and the three cover states follow that board
- Trim 240 × 300 mm, spine 12 mm, the six-column 29.5 mm grid and the ink #1B2A4A appear on the specification sheet and again unchanged in the presentation document
- All eight plate spreads carry the four caption fields in order with the collection title, accession number and catalogue date and maker line exactly as recorded in 03-plate-records.md; the plate-13 caption prints "Venezia [Venice] : presso Antonio Zatta, 1777." and the plate-14 caption prints "London, 1786."
- Every plate spread closes its caption with "Wellcome Collection" and the rights label Public Domain Mark, and the plate-10 caption prints both "No date recorded" and "No maker recorded"
- The plate-01 spread in Chapter 1 and the plate-10 spread in Chapter 2 both name Ursa Major and cross-refer to each other by accession number 46448i and 46168i
- The five openers and the two index spreads each reproduce the plates named for them, so every supplied plate appears at least twice, and the text-heavy plate-14 and plate-18 spreads use the same column measure and the same lowest-34 mm caption zone as the plate-03 spread, and the five openers share one heading position and one folio treatment
- All three cover states print THE ENGRAVED SKY and "Nineteen Plates of the Historical Sky", the title stays legible in the 24 mm thumbnail state, and the three-dimensional state stands the copy on the table and in the daylight of empty-bookshop-table.png

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
